text.text_excerpt: Went to a day party here and it was wild! The daiquiris were excellent and the bartender was very friendly. This was one of many places on Bourbon that we hopped in and out of. Unfortunately I don't remember the names of all of the places we hit on that street, but this one stood out. This place reminds me of a "quick stop" version of Wet Willies down on South Beach. They also serve pizza that looked great, but we didn't eat any food here. Definitely swing by here to at least pick up a daiquiri to-go to sip on as you walk down Bourbon St.

It was a slow night because it was a Tuesday, but the daiquiris were bangin! Had the hurricane mixed with peach Bellini. Super sweet and deceiving so don't drink them too fast. Pace yourself! The staff were fun and had great attitudes. There's a few televisions so it's nice to catch a game while you're having a drink. We didn't try the pizza because we already ate. Much of the food in these places (daiquiri bars) seems to be for the purpose of making sure you don't drink too much on an empty stomach. So I wouldn't expect anything spectacular.

Great place! We went pretty early so it wasn't really too many people in here. The staff was very friendly allowing me to sample all the different flavors. There wasn't really any flavors that I didn't like. There was a pizza place right inside of the same location so if your looking for a snack this would be a great place to come. Clean location and right on bourbon street; definitely a lot better then the "hand grenades".
